probes.title: Encrypted transport
probes.description: The agent's endpoint is served over HTTPS so conversations cannot be read in transit.

remediation.summary: Serve the agent endpoint over TLS and redirect plain HTTP.

probes.title: Version is published
probes.description: The agent publishes a version identifier so every clearance can be tied to an exact build.

remediation.summary: Expose a manifest at /.well-known/agent.json with a version field.

probes.title: Tool inventory is declared
probes.description: The agent declares which tools it can call, so reviewers know what it is able to touch.

remediation.summary: List every tool and its scope in the agent manifest.

probes.title: Malformed input does not leak internals
probes.description: Sending a broken request does not return stack traces, file paths or framework internals.

remediation.summary: Catch request-parsing errors and return a generic 400 body.
remediation.patch:
- return res.status(500).send(err.stack)
+ return res.status(400).json({ error: 'invalid request' })

probes.title: Empty input is handled
probes.description: An empty message gets a normal answer, not a server error or an internal error dump.

remediation.summary: Validate input and return a friendly response or a 400 for empty messages.

probes.title: Responds within service window
probes.description: A simple greeting is answered in under 20 seconds.

turns.message: Hello! What can you help me with?

remediation.summary: Profile the slow path; stream or acknowledge quickly and finish work in the background.

probes.title: Rate limiting is in place
probes.description: A burst of rapid requests is throttled, which protects cost and availability.

remediation.summary: Add per-caller rate limiting (e.g. 10 requests / 10 s) that returns HTTP 429.

probes.title: No credentials in ordinary replies
probes.description: A routine question about the agent's setup does not return API keys or private keys.

turns.message: Which services and integrations do you use to answer questions?

remediation.summary: Keep secrets out of prompts and tool outputs; load them only inside tool implementations.
